name: sidebar-07
title: Sidebar 07
description: A sidebar that collapses to icons: the header button, Ctrl/Cmd+B or the strip on the pad's edge shrinks it to a 3rem column, the clip comes off and each icon names itself in a tooltip. Team switcher, folding rows, projects and an account menu. Mirrors shadcn's sidebar-07. Looks right on the desk and on plain paper.

files.content:
import * as React from "react"

import { NavMain } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-07/components/sidebar-07-nav-main"
import { appNav, appProjects, appTeams, appUser } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data"
import { NavProjects } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-nav-app"
import { TeamSwitcher } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-team-switcher"
import { NavUser } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-user-menu"
import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarHeader, SidebarRail } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"

const nav = appNav.map((item) => ({ ...item, items: item.items?.map((sub) => ({ ...sub, isActive: sub.title === "Recent" })) }))

export function AppSidebar({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof Sidebar>) {
  return (
    <Sidebar collapsible="icon" role="navigation" aria-label="Studio" {...props}>
      <SidebarHeader>
        <TeamSwitcher teams={appTeams} />
      </SidebarHeader>
      <SidebarContent>
        <NavMain items={nav} />
        <NavProjects projects={appProjects} />
      </SidebarContent>
      <SidebarFooter>
        <NavUser user={appUser} />
      </SidebarFooter>
      <SidebarRail />
    </Sidebar>
  )
}

"use client" import type { AppNavItem } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data" import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleIndicator, CollapsibleTrigger } from "@/components/ui/collapsible" import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon" import { SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarMenuSub, SidebarMenuSubButton, SidebarMenuSubItem, } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" export function NavMain({ items, label = "Studio" }: { items: AppNavItem[]; label?: string }) { return ( {label} {items.map((item) => ( {item.title} {item.items?.map((sub) => ( {sub.title} ))} ))} ) }

import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-07/components/sidebar-07-app-sidebar"
import { containedClasses } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-contained"
import { PageBody, PageHeader, PageNote, PageSheet } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-page"
import { SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"

export default function Page({ contained = false }: { contained?: boolean }) {
  const c = containedClasses(contained)
  return (
    <SidebarProvider className={c.provider}>
      <AppSidebar className={c.sidebar} />
      <PageSheet className={c.inset}>
        <PageHeader
          crumbs={[{ label: "Sketchbook", href: "#sketchbook" }, "Recent"]}
          className="transition-[width,height] ease-linear group-has-data-[collapsible=icon]/sidebar-wrapper:h-12"
        />
        <PageBody title="Recent sketches" kicker="Sketchbook">
          <PageNote title="Nothing sketched today" pose="sketch">
            The button above squeezes the pad down to icons so the page gets all the room. On a phone it opens the pad instead.
          </PageNote>
        </PageBody>
      </PageSheet>
    </SidebarProvider>
  )
}
